author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution: Photo: Bernard Gagnon, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Calle_del_Rastro_de_San_Francisco,_Lima.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: LLAMASE ASI POR LA EXISTENCIA DE UN RASTRO O
ESTABLECIMIENTO PARA LA VENTA DE CARNE.

notes: Barrington-sponsored tile plaque in Lima's historic centre: modern name 'JR. ANCASH CUADRA 2' on top, historic name 'Calle del Rastro de San Francisco' in decorative letters (the DE is a small D-with-E ligature), explanatory text, 'Ceram Iturry' maker mark. Painted paint-stratigraphy test patches at right are a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Calle del Rastro de San Francisco, Lima.jpg

lines.text: LLAMADA ASI POR EL PREDOMINIO DE ESTABLECIMIENTOS DE

notes: Barrington-sponsored tile plaque on an orange wall in central Lima: modern name 'Jr. de la Union, cuadra 4' plus historic 'Calle de Mercaderes'. Same plaque series as c46495665 but a different street. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution: Photo: Bernard Gagnon, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Calle_del_Mirador_de_Santa_Clara,_Trujillo,_Peru.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: DESDE DONDE SE OBSERVABA LA HUERTA Y LAS CELDAS
DEL CONVENTO DE CLAUSURA DE SANTA CLARA.

notes: Two tile plaques in Trujillo: upper Barrington plaque with Trujillo coat of arms (historic 'Calle del Mirador de Santa Clara', DE written as a D-with-E ligature, 'Ceram Iturry Lima-Perú' maker mark); lower green-and-white municipal plaque with left arrow and a Cerveza Pilsen Trujillo emblem. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Calle del Mirador de Santa Clara, Trujillo, Peru.jpg
source_categories: Street signs with explanation in Peru

author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution: Photo: Bernard Gagnon, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Street_sign_in_Tumbes.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Two green street blades on a pole in Tumbes with block numbers and arrows; city coat of arms at right (ring text 'KAROLI CESARIS AUSPITIO ET LABORE INGENIO AC IMPENSA DUCIS PIZARRO INVENTA ET PACATA', small). Upper blade is shaded and partly faded. Torn posters on the poles ('ATENCIÓN TUMBES !!!', 'SOY + PRODUCCIONES') are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
